title: Four Thousand Weeks: Time and How to Use It
author: Oliver Burkeman
summary: Oliver Burkeman argues that the urge to master time is a trap, since an average life is only about four thousand weeks. He proposes accepting our limits and choosing what to neglect.
readIf: you feel overwhelmed and want a calm, philosophical take on time rather than more tips.
skipIf: you want a system or list of productivity hacks.
